lessons: Root cause is the environment, not the diff. tests/integration/test_mcp_app_dashboard.py::test_dashboard_bundle calls dev.build_ui_bundle, which needs <worktree>/node_modules/.bin/esbuild, and ticket worktree provisioning does not supply it. The other 17 tests passed.

A human should let ticket ui-bundle-worktree-node-modules (confirmed on main) land first, or otherwise provision node_modules or esbuild in ticket worktrees. Then rerun Check on this branch unchanged. The fix belongs to the engine's worktree setup, outside this fence.

Do not retry the implementer with a workaround such as a node_modules symlink or skipping test_dashboard_bundle. dev.py and worktree provisioning are outside the fence, and box-001181-c4d3edba already records the provisioning gap.

The implementer said test_dashboard_bundle also fails on base for missing esbuild, but did not run the plain ## Verification command on base, since the new test file does not exist there. After provisioning is fixed, rerun the full Verification command on the branch to confirm.
